newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt state to sell rice mill through bids.
newsitem.headline: Egypt state to sell rice mill through bids.

text.p: Egypt's state-owned Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills on Saturday offered to sell a rice mill in the Mediterranean city of Alexandria through a tender using sealed bids.
It said in a published advertisement the Semouha mill could produce 96 tonnes of white rice a day. The deadline for bids is May 8 at noon (1000 GMT).
Investors must pay 250,000 pounds ($73,600) as an initial deposit, the company said.
State-owned National Bank of Egypt is the agent for the sale.

The state has sold part of its stake in several flour milling firms over the past 18 months but officials have often said the government will maintain control over the sector because of its "strategic" nature.
